exclusion_reason: The recompiler lowers a bounded register-and-stack 32-bit integer subset (mov, the full ALU space, inc/dec, push/pop, test, direct branches, and ret) bit-exact against the interpreter oracle, but memory-operand forms, wider/narrower operand sizes, x87/MMX/SSE, and indirect control flow still refuse, so a whole real PE32 `.text` cannot yet be recompiled end to end.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when the translator emits WebAssembly for a whole fixture `.text`, the recompiled trace is bit-exact against the interpreter oracle across the trace, and the hot path carries no silent fallback for any instruction the fixture reaches.
expected_failing_assertion: A whole-guest fixture reaches an instruction outside the recompiled subset (a memory operand or an indirect branch), which the recompiler refuses rather than lowering, so no end-to-end recompiled trace clears the bit-exact bar yet.
active_gate_evidence: test/recompile.test.mjs assembles microprograms, maps them, and runs each through both executeProbe (the BPTK-009 oracle) and the emitted WebAssembly module, asserting the exact register, eflags, trace_sha256, memory_sha256, stop_reason, and instruction count agree across mov/ALU/inc/dec/push/pop/test, every conditional-branch condition code, forward and backward direct branches, and the instruction-budget-exhausted boundary; it also pins that an opcode outside the subset and a memory-operand form each refuse with a structured code and fallback_count zero, so the hot path never silently falls back to the interpreter.
procedure: Translate the fixture image `.text` to a WebAssembly module ahead of time.
Execute the recompiled module and the interpreter oracle over the same trace and compare guest register, flag, and memory state at every step.
Assert that no hot-path instruction falls back to the interpreter without a declared reason.
pass_criterion: The recompiled trace is bit-exact against the interpreter oracle across the fixture trace.
No hot-path instruction falls back to the interpreter silently.
